reviews.text: Hello everyone! Good afternoon. I want to leave a record of my experience at this place. The first time I took my pet, Tonny, a 12-year-old medium-sized Cane Corso, the service was okay! However, the second time I noticed difficulties scheduling appointments. They said the schedule was full, but that wasn't true because other people told me they had contacted them and there were available times. I scheduled an appointment for a bath, and they cancelled at the last minute without even giving me the option to reschedule. It would be more honest to say that they prefer to bathe smaller pets. Since they cater to the pet segment, they should know that each animal has its own characteristics and peculiarities. Tonny is an elderly dog, but very sweet and affectionate. I found it disrespectful and negligent. If they prefer to cater to smaller pets, they should make that clear and be more honest than scheduling and then cancelling! Terrible attitude, lack of professionalism, disappointed!
